text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp. An unexpected 
savior appeared before Super Creek, who 
had been struggling with a slump!

Bwahahaha! Looks like you're havin' quite 
a rough time, Creek!

I'll gladly lend ya a hand. Yeah, with 
this—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell no! That's my best pal Tamamo Cross! 
Nice timing on that straight-man quip, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right then, Creek, here I come! Try and 
beat me in a beach sprint!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* My legs... can't take much 
more...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're completely exhausted. Times like 
this call for THAT! Show 'em THAT!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's right, "guts"! It happened 'cause 
you don't have enough spirit!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What good is having such a lazy-ass 
attitude? If ya wanna pamper your Trainer, 
put your back into it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: For Trainer's sake... For Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, what in the world is goin' on?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It turned out just as I expected.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's weird. I totally thought she 
was just lacking guts.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, you'll never be a match for 
me, no matter how long it takes.
choice_data_list: Creek, do you have a sec?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, I'm 
sorry...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even though this was all for you, 
Trainer... I was just not strong enough...
choice_data_list:
If it's too much alone, shall we pair up 
and run?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, team up...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's that? You and Creek are gonna do 
a relay together?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's ridiculous... Even if someone who 
ain't an Umamusume helps out, there's only 
so much they can do.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's fine then. I'll give ya a 
little handicap, too. You go ahead and 
start first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――Leave the anchor leg to Super Creek, and 
start off with an all-out sprint!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat?! You're pretty fast! That's 
mighty impressive!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, when did you build up this much 
stamina...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spending time with Super Creek has 
definitely improved my own stamina as 
well. In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's the end of your handicap. If 
you're goin' that far, I'm comin' at ya 
with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Overtaken by Tamamo Cross in an instant. 
Even so, mustering every ounce of 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Come here, Trainer, right over by 
my side.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the verge of losing consciousness, I 
pass the baton to Super Creek. And then—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Wait right there, Tama-chan. Hyaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah, what is that?! Look at Creek go!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I will win, I will win, I will win, win, 
wiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Together, the two of us definitely will—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stood up—it was already dusk. The 
result was...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's a loss, a plain old loss. I 
always thought other people just hold ya 
back, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The handicap early on took a toll, and 
Creek's momentum was completely on another 
level. What on earth just happened?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand. But my chest didn't 
tighten up like it used to, and my body 
just moved on its own...
choice_data_list: Let me help out, at least a little.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that her sense of 
responsibility—trying to shoulder 
everything alone—was indeed the cause of 
her slump.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I told her, "There are things I can 
do too. Please, rely on me a little more"—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, oh dear... So that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I always felt like I had to work hard 
enough for my Trainer too. And because of 
that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see~. So ya mean I was actually tryin' 
way too hard, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sounds just like Creek. But noticing that 
and actually lecturing her? That's pretty 
impressive.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer has become so remarkable. And 
yet, I didn't even notice it..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're such a good person, Trainer, and 
yet I'm the only bad one~. Uuu~...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes... I really want to talk with 
you more, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you tell me all about how much 
stronger you've become, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, now that's true Naniwa 
hospitality! Ain't that great, Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, are you even listening to me?! I'm 
not just here for decoration, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help Super Creek relax, I set a more 
relaxed schedule for this summer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And several weeks later—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we had so much fun playing every 
day, didn't we? We even fed each other at 
the night stalls♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"A part of me just wants to keep playing 
around like this forever. I really am 
hopeless, aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~ Thanks to you, I was 
able to relax. Very much so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though I'm gently being healed 
from the inside out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A smile just like when we first met. I was 
finally able to do at least one thing for 
Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, the training camp is 
still going, but what should we do with 
the rest of our time?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"A sumo tournament... On the beach? Fufu, 
sounds lovely~♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to lose, though~. I'll give 
you a big squeeze and roll you right over. 
Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to enjoy the remaining days 
without overworking ourselves. Super Creek 
built up her power while having fun.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A test of courage... Sure, but I tend to 
be a bit off-key with that sort of thing.
choice_data_list: Out of alignment? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Whenever a ghost appears, it always takes 
me a while to notice it~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And then a few seconds later, she went, 
"Eeeek!" Please don't laugh, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, just as she'd said during the 
test of courage, Super Creek seemed to 
have gained some guts through play.
